warnings: The reference dataset is adult male only; do not reuse its muscle meshes as female anatomy.
A named concept may contain multiple source element meshes. Preserve the element list and do not assume one concept equals one OBJ.
The manifest stores geometry in binary chunks. This audit inspected metadata only; binary geometry has not yet been downloaded, decoded, rendered, or visually verified.
System labels are source viewer groupings, not an independent anatomical truth. For example tibialis anterior appears under skeletal.
A mesh being present does not establish its correct mapping to the project's four MuscleMap views or the exact training target boundaries.
